kpis.description_fr: Specialty Medicines (oncology + HIV + Nucala + Trelegy). Plus gros segment GSK post-Haleon spin. Growth driver.
kpis.description_en: Specialty Medicines (oncology + HIV + Nucala + Trelegy). Largest GSK segment post-Haleon spin. Growth driver.

kpis.description_fr: Shingrix (vaccine zona). #1 vaccine GSK. Maturation USA + expansion EU/APAC.
kpis.description_en: Shingrix (shingles vaccine). #1 GSK vaccine. US maturation + EU/APAC expansion.

kpis.description_fr: Arexvy = 1er vaccine RSV monde (adults 60+). Launched 2023, ramp 2024. Concurrence Pfizer Abrysvo + Moderna mRNA.
kpis.description_en: Arexvy = world's 1st RSV vaccine (adults 60+). Launched 2023, 2024 ramp. Pfizer Abrysvo + Moderna mRNA competition.

kpis.description_fr: ViiV Healthcare (HIV) = 78% GSK détient. Dolutegravir + Cabotegravir LA. Crown jewel HIV (vs Gilead).
kpis.description_en: ViiV Healthcare (HIV) = 78% GSK-owned. Dolutegravir + Cabotegravir LA. HIV crown jewel (vs Gilead).

kpis.description_fr: NMEs en Phase III (new molecular entities). Bigger pipeline post-Bellus Health + Aiolos Bio + Iyengar. Catalyst growth 2026+.
kpis.description_en: Phase III NMEs (new molecular entities). Bigger pipeline post-Bellus Health + Aiolos Bio + Iyengar. 2026+ growth catalyst.

kpis_story.description_fr: Settlement Zantac (ranitidine + cancer claims) ~$2.2Md octobre 2024. Reduce litigation overhang. Catalyst re-rating actions GSK.
kpis_story.description_en: $2.2B Zantac (ranitidine + cancer claims) settlement October 2024. Reduces litigation overhang. GSK share re-rating catalyst.

kpis_story.description_fr: Cabenuva injectable Q2 (vs daily oral) = 1er long-acting HIV treatment. Moat ViiV. Cabotegravir Phase III PrEP (anti-Gilead Lenacapavir).
kpis_story.description_en: Cabenuva Q2 injectable (vs daily oral) = 1st long-acting HIV treatment. ViiV moat. Cabotegravir Phase III PrEP (anti-Gilead Lenacapavir).

_notes: GSK.L = UK pharma post-Haleon spin 2022 (pure-play Bio Pharma). Modèle vaccines (Shingrix, Arexvy) + ViiV HIV + Specialty Medicines.
